source_summary: Monochrome ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with misty distant mountains, layered riverbanks, foreground pine-and-rock terraces, a small scholar retreat, and a boat on open water. Seals, inscription, borders, and paper staining are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: misty_distant_mountains
motifs.description: Isolate the upper background mountain chain: soft layered peaks from left-center through right side, including the darker central crags, pale receding ridgelines, vertical cliff washes, and clusters of tiny pine silhouettes on ridges. Exclude red seals and empty surrounding paper.
must_preserve: graded ink wash on cliff faces
pale receding ridgelines behind main peaks

motifs.name: middle_sandbars_and_river_mist
motifs.description: Isolate the broad horizontal middle-ground water and sandbar zone beneath the mountains, with layered banks, low islands, thin ink shorelines, and mist-softened transitions across the river plain.

motifs.name: right_hillside_path_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right hillside with sloping path, clustered bare trees and shrubs, small roofed structures partly hidden among trees, and rounded rocks below the bank. Keep the connected hillside mass but exclude distant mountains above and open water to the left.
must_preserve: dark shrub dots and texture clusters
rounded rock washes and contour cracks

motifs.name: central_rock_outcrop_and_leafless_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the central rocky promontory projecting into open water, with large dark boulders, eroded ink washes, sparse leafless trees, and low shrubs on the ridge.
must_preserve: vertical wash streaks on rock faces

motifs.name: boat_with_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the small covered boat on the lower-right water with two seated figures and one standing or rowing figure, including the arched canopy, pointed bow, stern platform, oar lines, and light reddish color accents on figures.

motifs.name: scholar_retreat_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left pavilion retreat: open-sided thatched or tiled roof structure with seated scholars, railings, furniture, nearby shrubs, and the small bridge/stream edge at the far left. Exclude the large central pines where possible except branches that overlap the retreat.
must_preserve: precise roof eaves and support posts
small arched bridge and stream strokes
dense dotted shrubs and garden rocks

motifs.name: foreground_tall_pine_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the tall foreground pine group rising from the lower center: multiple straight trunks, dark bark strokes, spreading needle clusters, and the arcing branch network crossing the open water behind.
must_preserve: overlapping branch transparency against pale water

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank_and_bending_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground rocky terrace and sweeping right-bending pine: layered bank contours, dark rocks at the base, the low arcing trunk extending rightward, sparse needle tufts, and small leafless shrubs along the bank. Exclude the signature at far right.
must_preserve: mist-soft lower edge of the bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
